scope: iOS app process, synthetic loopback fixture, Release simulator; one workflow capture per view. Navigation and catalogs have clean before/after captures; playback and cycles have clean baseline-only captures.

measurement_method.cpu_units: percent of one host core; Mach ticks calibrated with mach_timebase_info (125/3 nanoseconds per tick)
measurement_method.footprint_units: MiB charged physical footprint at the end of the settled window
measurement_method.settled_window: two-second settle followed by eight seconds of sampling; final cycle settles for 45 seconds
limitations: Host load varies and each view has one capture.
Simulator captures omit physical-device thermal, GPU/decoder-service, HDR, and display-pacing behavior.
This partial comparison supports no app-wide CPU, memory, FPS, hitch, or zero-leak claim.

clean_environment.accepted_capture_contract: Every accepted report had capture.valid=true, no PosterBoard or SpringBoard incidents, and Instruments exit code 0.

excluded_campaign: All original ios-baseline and ios-optimized per-view captures are excluded because they overlapped PosterBoard crashes.

playback.after: not captured; owner ended profiling to prioritize dogfood fixes

cycles.after: not captured; owner ended profiling to prioritize dogfood fixes

standalone_cancellation_stress.status: accepted only for this deterministic fresh-host-process fixture; not an app-wide view-performance claim
standalone_cancellation_stress.preserved_contract: Both retained images were 400x600 and the shared URL made one request.

service_boundary_checks.status: accepted deterministic code-path checks; not simulator view-performance claims
service_boundary_checks.metadata_history: 640 resolved tracks retains 512 lookup-history entries while the resolved queue remains 640
service_boundary_checks.requests_ready_framing: five reads make one ready-framing request

remaining_measurement_limits: Optimized playback and cycles were not captured because the owner ended profiling to prioritize dogfood fixes.
The clean five-cycle baseline is flat from 77.9 to 77.7 MiB; it does not demonstrate a leak fix.
Slow-server rapid-track-change playback-report backlog and foreground-independent Sonos polling remain separate measurement targets.
